<button class="accordion">Keyboard shortcuts</button>
::: panel

The most common keyboard shortcuts are provided below for Windows and Mac operating systems.

:::{style="background-color: white; font-size: 14px;"}
|Task                         | Windows          | Mac
|:----------------------------|:----------------:|:-------------------:|
| View all keyboard shortcuts | Alt + &#8679; + K | &#8997; + &#8679; + K
| Open an existing script     | Ctrl + O         | &#8984; + O
| Create a new script         | Ctrl + &#8679; + N | &#8984; + &#8679; + N
| Save script file            | Ctrl + S         | &#8984; + S
| Execute code                | Ctrl + Enter     | &#8984; + Return
| Copy                        | Ctrl + C         | &#8984; + C
| Paste                       | Ctrl + V         | &#8984; + V
| Add a pipe operator         | Ctrl + &#8679; + M | &#8984; + &#8679; + M
| Add an assignment operator  | Alt + dash       | &#8997; + dash
| Add a new code section      | Ctrl + &#8679; + R | &#8984; + &#8679; + R
| Indent code                 | Ctrl + I         | &#8984; + I
:::
